name: keep_crossed
notes: Training keeps windows with crossed/locked recorded minutes (max_crossed 0 -> 99: never drops; a window counts at most 14). Those minutes stay untradeable (data.market_to_rows: no two-sided book = no quote; maker fills need candle k+1 to trade and close on a book), and validation/test windows were already kept whole, so only the training-window selection changes. Historical-tier storage turns only an empty ask ($1.00) into $0.01 and a minute counts as crossed only with bid > 0, so the drop can remove YES-settling windows from training only (an outcome-selected training set that over-values NO). Gate fixed before running (outcomes only, no P&L, windows opening 2026-04-18..2026-06-16, never scored out of sample): dropped windows' P(settle YES) exceeds kept windows' by >= 5 points AND the trainable pool's P(YES) is >= 1 point below all windows'. One value, no sweep. If the gate passes this is a training-data correctness fix, adopted as the engine default whatever this run's out-of-sample result. GATE PASSED (diag run 42088067536, Nov 5): windows before Jun 17: 2911 of 22440 dropped, P(YES) dropped 0.9993 vs kept 0.4183; training pool 0.4180 vs all 0.4937. Whole historical tier: 13% of windows dropped, all YES; pool P(YES) 0.423 vs 0.498 (live tier: none dropped, 0.500). An empty YES ask is a near-certain YES, so the drop removed late YES winners from training only: the NO tilt of every card so far.
